# Evaluations

BDD specs answer “can the workflow do the right thing?” Evaluations answer the harder question: “how often does it do the right thing?”

## This Chapter Will Cover

- When specs are enough (workflow correctness) vs when you need evals (quality + reliability)
- The evaluation workflow: dataset → runs → metrics → thresholds
- Basic metrics you can trust (success rate, constraint violations)
- Using model-graded metrics carefully (and how to keep them honest)
- Running evaluations and interpreting results over time

## How It Connects to the Running Example

We’ll build a small dataset of messy notes inputs and measure:

- Does the agent reliably extract action items?
- Are recap emails concise and readable?
- Does the workflow consistently enforce the approval gate?
